“The Greatest Game of All Time”: Amid Phenomenal Reviews of GTA VI, Take-Two’s Market Value Rises
Published by
admin
Tags:
GTA VI
,
Take-Two
This afternoon, November 18, professional critics began publishing reviews dedicated to GTA VI. They were very pleased with what they saw in the game.
GTA VI
At the time of writing, GTA VI
received
a score of 99 out of 100 possible points on Metacritic. Almost everything in the game was praised: from the intricately detailed open world to the gripping storyline and excellent graphics. In some reviews, GTA VI was even called the best game in history. As for the few shortcomings, critics listed frame rate drops in complex scenes and an uneven pacing of the narrative.
Thanks to such a warm reception, Take-Two Interactive — the parent company of Rockstar Games, the developer of GTA VI — immediately began to see its value increase.
According to the NASDAQ exchange, in pre-market trading, the stock price of Take-Two
jumped
to $218 per share. For comparison, just last night, they were priced 6.9% lower. As a result of this jump, the market value of the entire company reached $40.7 billion.
It is possible that the price of Take-Two will increase even further in the near future. In any case, the company is likely to profit greatly from the game. According to
analysts’ calculations
from Sensor Tower, the number of pre-orders for GTA VI currently exceeds 17 million copies, indicating a gross revenue of $1.65 billion.
It should be noted that gamers in New Zealand have already had the opportunity to play GTA VI, but the game will become available worldwide a little later. It officially releases on November 19 at midnight local time.
